entities.summary: Pros Mund was a Danish-Norwegian admiral during the Thirty Years War. He saw action as a commander in the Torstenson War against Sweden and died at sea in battle. French admiral Abraham Duquesne, at the time serving Sweden after having secured Mazarin’s permission, captured his flagship at the Battle of Fehmarn.
